initial_prompt: Create a square production game albedo texture only, no scene, no roof illustration, no shingles, no tile outlines or grid, no text, no lighting or shadows, no objects. A continuous hand-painted slate mineral colour field for a mature Gothic storybook apothecary, soft opaque gouache from a traditional 1990s animated background. Dominant desaturated mossy blue-grey, gentle weathered grey-green, organically intermingled muted sage regions. Medium-dark values, restrained hue differences, clearly visible broad intentional overlapping dry brush strokes and broken painted edges, not photorealistic stone or photographic noise. Large asymmetric organic cloud-like painted colour groups across whole image that blend through intermediate hues, a few restrained softened olive moss stains near scattered brush seams. No sharply bordered rectangular areas, no repetitive pattern, no glossy highlights, no black cracks, no fine gritty surface noise, no blur. Flat evenly lit matte colour texture, full bleed, calm but expressive brushwork; designed to be mapped continuously across many 30cm roof slates, so do not paint individual slates.
refinement_prompt: Edit this game albedo texture into a MUCH CALMER hand-painted gouache slate colour field. Keep the mossy blue-grey dominant palette and organic painterly shapes, but compress all light/dark differences substantially: colour groups should be gentle, not strongly mottled. Remove the granular/gritty photographic-looking texture and scratchy little marks. Replace fine surface detail with a limited number of broad, smooth opaque hand-painted brush strokes, clean simple shapes, occasional visible soft dry-brush edges, muted sage and weathered slate undertones. Not blur: deliberately simplified painted artwork with crisp but low-contrast brush shapes. Aim traditional animated storybook background paint. Mostly quiet blue-grey with small restrained moss-olive accents, no washed-out pastel, no shine. No tiles, no seams, no geometry, no text; this is a continuous full-bleed material colour texture.
geometry: Existing corrected source refined; shared slope grid and measured intersections preserved.
